business_problem: Aye needed to prove that face-based payments could resist photos, videos, deepfakes, masks, and replay attacks while still delivering a smooth checkout experience that merchants and end users would trust.
solution_summary: Aye Solutions works with Tencent Cloud to make AyeFace, its face-payment and retail AI-agent platform, trustworthy enough for everyday checkout use. The core requirement is not just facial recognition accuracy but resilient liveness detection and identity verification that can withstand photos, videos, deepfakes, masks, and replay attacks without adding friction to the payment flow. Tencent Cloud contributes cybersecurity and biometric-technology expertise at large-user scale, and Aye uses that partnership as both a technical control layer and a credibility signal for merchants adopting face-based payments. The vendor relationship also includes 24/7 support from teams in Malaysia, Singapore, and the wider region, which helps Aye troubleshoot quickly as it expands across Southeast Asia. In practice, the solution blends biometric security controls with AyeFace's retail AI experiences so secure authentication and customer automation can grow together.

solution_components.name: AyeFace
solution_components.role: Acts as the merchant-facing AI-agent and face-payment application used in retail settings.

solution_components.name: Tencent Cloud Biometric Technology
solution_components.role: Supplies the biometric capabilities that strengthen face-based authentication.

solution_components.name: Liveness Detection
solution_components.role: Detects spoof attempts such as photos, videos, masks, and replay attacks during authentication.

solution_components.name: Identity Verification
solution_components.role: Validates the user behind a payment attempt as part of the checkout flow.

solution_components.name: Tencent Cloud Cybersecurity Technology
solution_components.role: Provides the security credibility and technical support layer behind the payment solution.

data_flow: A customer initiates a face-based payment through AyeFace, biometric and liveness checks run against Tencent Cloud-backed controls, identity verification confirms the user, and the result feeds Aye's retail customer-service and sales-assistant experiences.
integration_points: Regional support teams in Malaysia and Singapore
business_outcome: Aye strengthened trust in face-based payments, gained a stronger enterprise-security position with merchants, and built a foundation for expanding secure AI-assisted checkout across Southeast Asia.
metrics: Aye has worked with Tencent Cloud for about 2 years.
Tencent has more than 1,000 employees working on biometric cybersecurity.
Tencent describes its cybersecurity technology as proven at the scale of billions of users.
architecture_clues: The deployment ties secure biometric controls directly to a customer-facing face-payment product.
